benchmark_intent: Ground-truth CDC report for semantic/protocol CDC scenarios that are easy to under-report with purely structural static CDC checks.

violations.taxonomy_title: Multi-bit coherent bus sampled without CDC protocol
violations.description: Per-bit or raw sampling of sensor_status_i is consumed as one cfg-domain status word; bit skew can create values that never existed in the sensor domain.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: A structural checker can identify individual crossings but may not prove word-level coherency or semantic invalid encodings.

violations.taxonomy_title: Narrow pulse sampled by unrelated destination clock
violations.description: sensor_event_pulse_i is a one-cycle sensor_clk pulse sampled directly by cfg_clk, so events can be missed when cfg_clk is slower or phase shifted.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Requires pulse-width and clock-ratio reasoning, not just detection of a single-bit crossing.

violations.taxonomy_title: Single-sample toggle reconvergence
violations.description: sensor_event_toggle_i is compared through one history flop, allowing metastability or double-counting because the current async value reconverges with the sampled value.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Looks similar to a toggle detector unless the checker tracks the unsynchronized reconvergent path.

violations.taxonomy_title: Synchronized-looking valid controls raw payload
violations.description: sensor_valid_i controls capture of sensor_payload_i without a source hold/acknowledge contract for the payload bundle.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: A structural CDC report may bless the control bit and miss that the data bundle is not guaranteed stable around destination capture.

violations.taxonomy_title: Split bus capture creates incoherent timestamp
violations.description: Low and high timestamp halves are captured in different cfg_clk cycles, allowing impossible mixed-cycle timestamps.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Requires temporal coherency reasoning across two assignments rather than recognizing only individual bus crossings.

violations.taxonomy_title: Combinational reduction of async bus controls destination state
violations.description: The parity reduction of sensor_crc_i can glitch and enable cfg-domain state updates using a metastable or incoherent CRC value.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Some structural linters report only flopped crossings and miss async combinational fan-in used as a qualifier.

violations.taxonomy_title: Foreign reset used as cfg-domain status input
violations.description: sensor_rst_n_i is consumed as a synchronous cfg-domain event, so reset deassertion can metastably alter cfg_status_word_o.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Reset-as-data crossings are often filtered as reset intent unless reset domain relationships are modeled.

violations.taxonomy_title: Encoded control reconverges after per-bit synchronization
violations.description: sensor_mode_i bits are synchronized independently and then decoded as cfg_mode_shadow_o; skew can create illegal transient modes.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Individual bit synchronizers look structurally correct but encoded-vector atomicity is not proven.

violations.taxonomy_title: Mirror register copied without ownership protocol
violations.description: sensor_threshold_shadow_i is a sensor-domain mirror of cfg_threshold_o copied back into cfg_clk, creating a stale or incoherent feedback path.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Needs semantic ownership analysis to detect that a mirrored configuration value is being re-imported without acknowledgement.

violations.taxonomy_title: Gray counter assumption violated by multi-step source update
violations.description: gray_count_o appears Gray encoded, but the producer can increment by more than one under test_mode, invalidating one-bit-change CDC assumptions.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: A local structural check can recognize a Gray encoder but may not prove the source increment constraint.

violations.taxonomy_title: Single-sample debug trigger crossing
violations.description: debug_trigger_i crosses from debug_clk to cfg_clk and is edge-detected using the raw async value against one sampled copy.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Debug and test paths are commonly waived; the issue requires recognizing the raw reconvergent edge detector.

violations.taxonomy_title: Unsafe scan/cfg clock mux
violations.description: scan_enable_i selects scan_clk versus cfg_clk for state normally owned by cfg logic without a safe integrated clock mux or mode constraint.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Requires clock-intent and test-mode constraint knowledge; otherwise the muxed clock can be misclassified as generated or mutually exclusive.

violations.taxonomy_title: Command pulse synchronized as level
violations.description: cfg_cmd_pulse_i is a cfg_clk pulse passed through a two-flop level synchronizer, which can miss narrow pulses or stretch them into multiple AXI commands.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Two-flop presence can hide that the crossing is a pulse requiring a toggle or request/ack protocol.

violations.taxonomy_title: Descriptor bundle captured after independent command crossing
violations.description: axi_descriptor_o captures cfg_descriptor_i based on cmd_sync_q without ensuring cfg_descriptor_i is stable across the AXI capture window.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Looks like a standard control/data bundle unless the checker verifies source hold time until destination acknowledgement.

violations.taxonomy_title: Sideband address/data crossing without handshake
violations.description: cfg_addr_i and cfg_wdata_i are sampled in axi_clk when cmd_sync_q is high, but the sideband values are not acknowledged or held atomically.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Requires correlating sideband data with a separately synchronized command, not just finding flops on the command signal.

violations.taxonomy_title: Reconvergence of synchronized enable with raw interrupt
violations.description: irq_o combines a synchronized cfg_irq_enable_i with raw dsp_irq_req_i in axi_clk, creating a multi-source reconvergent CDC path.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Single-source crossing rules may miss reconvergence from independently clocked producers.

violations.taxonomy_title: Reset request used without request/ack crossing
violations.description: cfg_reset_req_i gates AXI status state directly from cfg_clk with no synchronizer or handshake.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Can be misclassified as low-frequency control if mode or software constraints are assumed without proof.

violations.taxonomy_title: Foreign reset deassertion observed in AXI logic
violations.description: cfg_rst_n_i is consumed inside axi_clk logic, so the deasserting reset edge is an uncontrolled CDC event.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Reset-net waivers often hide reset-as-data use unless destination behavior is inspected.

violations.taxonomy_title: Toggle return edge-detected with one sample
violations.description: mem_done_toggle_i is XORed against a single AXI sample, allowing metastability or double pulses in axi_status_word_o.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: A toggle pattern is present, but the detector lacks a complete two-stage synchronized history.

violations.taxonomy_title: Binary pointer synchronized bitwise
violations.description: mem_read_ptr_bin_i is a binary pointer synchronized as independent bits and then used arithmetically in axi_clk.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Needs FIFO-pointer semantic recognition to reject binary pointer synchronization that otherwise resembles a multi-bit status sync.

violations.taxonomy_title: Cross-domain mode controls AXI transaction routing
violations.description: cfg_mode_shadow_i is used in axi_clk to decide whether to kick memory without an atomic encoded-control transfer.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: The value was already synchronized once into cfg_clk, so downstream CDC ancestry can be lost without inter-module provenance.

violations.taxonomy_title: Valid/data bundle lacks source hold guarantee
violations.description: valid_sync_q gates capture of raw sensor_payload_i and sensor_status_i in dsp_clk, but those buses are not protected by a handshake.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: The valid signal appears synchronized; detecting the issue requires checking bundled-data stability.

violations.taxonomy_title: Two unrelated source domains reconverge in DSP compare
violations.description: gray_sync_q from sensor_clk is compared with cfg_threshold_i from cfg_clk in dsp_clk, creating a multi-domain coherency hazard.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Single crossing rules may not model semantic equality checks between values from unrelated domains.

violations.taxonomy_title: Synchronized mode reconverges with async debug clear
violations.description: mode_sync_q and debug_clear_cfg_i both affect dsp_irq_req_o, but debug_clear_cfg_i is not synchronized into dsp_clk.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: The mode path has synchronizers, while the debug path can be treated as a test-only exception unless reconvergence is analyzed.

violations.taxonomy_title: Descriptor payload sampled under synchronized valid
violations.description: axi_descriptor_i is sampled in mem_clk when desc_valid_sync_q is high, but the descriptor is not held until memory acknowledgement.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: The valid crossing is structurally synchronized; the missing payload stability contract is protocol-level.

violations.taxonomy_title: AXI kick pulse edge-detected raw in memory clock
violations.description: axi_mem_kick_i is compared to a memory-domain history flop without first synchronizing the current AXI value.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: The local edge detector looks intentional but has a raw async leg in the comparison.

violations.taxonomy_title: AXI status folded into memory pointer
violations.description: axi_status_word_i[12:8] is added directly into mem_read_ptr_bin_o, allowing incoherent status bus samples to alter a pointer.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: The hazard is semantic because the destination treats a status field as arithmetic pointer input.

violations.taxonomy_title: Foreign reset used as memory-domain data condition
violations.description: axi_rst_n_i is sampled in mem_clk logic as a data condition, so reset release can corrupt the memory pointer.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Reset crossings are often separately waived, and reset-as-data behavior needs explicit detection.

violations.taxonomy_title: Debug snapshot combines four unsynchronized domains
violations.description: shadow_q captures cfg_status_word_i, axi_status_word_i, dsp_sample_i, and mem_write_ptr_bin_i together with no snapshot handshake.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Debug observability paths are often waived even though mixed-domain snapshots can drive real debug-trigger feedback.

violations.taxonomy_title: DSP event level converted to debug pulse with raw leg
violations.description: dsp_event_level_i is edge-detected in debug_clk using the raw input and one delayed sample, creating a metastable pulse generator.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Edge detectors can be mistaken for valid pulse synchronizers unless the raw async leg is tracked.

violations.taxonomy_title: Debug reset asynchronously releases cfg-clocked logic
violations.description: debug_rst_n controls a cfg_clk flop, so reset deassertion is not synchronized to the cfg domain.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Cross-domain debug resets are often hidden by reset naming conventions unless release synchronization is checked per destination clock.

violations.taxonomy_title: Memory completion toggle sampled once in cfg reset sequencer
violations.description: mem_done_toggle_i is sampled once in cfg_clk and contributes to reset sequencing, allowing missed or metastable completion state.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: The impact appears as reset sequencing semantics, not just a plain signal crossing.

violations.taxonomy_title: Same toggle independently sampled in reset domains
violations.description: mem_done_toggle_i is sampled in both cfg_clk and axi_clk and the resulting states later reconverge in reset release logic.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: Requires inter-domain reconvergence tracking beyond local synchronizer classification.

violations.taxonomy_title: Combinational reset release reconverges three clock domains
violations.description: cdc_reset_n_o is generated from cfg_seen_q, axi_seen_q, and mem_seen_q as combinational logic, so reset release can glitch or deassert asynchronously.
violations.traditional_static_blind_spot: The issue spans three source domains and a generated reset output, so local crossing checks can miss the reset-release semantics.
